purpose: Rebaseline Leshy2 around S3-local UI, maximum legal display throughput, two locality-first RP2354B domains, analog 5.8-GHz FPV reception and mandatory receive-only 118-137-MHz Airband AM without losing the accepted radio, expansion, safety, service, audio or storage capabilities.

accepted_scope.user_acceptance: Analog 5.8-GHz FPV is accepted if the remaining architecture stays optimal; display performance is maximized and ordinary UI buttons remain on an S3-local I2C expander path without crossing RP IPC.
accepted_scope.fpv: Receive-only analog NTSC/PAL FPV. DJI, Walksnail, HDZero and other proprietary digital video systems are outside R2.
accepted_scope.external_rf_interface: User-facing MMCX labelled FPV RX 5.8G; U.FL is permitted only as an internal module interconnect.
accepted_scope.production_boundary: The base PCB contains the video decoder and a replaceable receiver bay. The exact serial 5.8-GHz receiver module and exact MMCX MPN must close in H1 before placement is accepted.
accepted_scope.airband_acceptance: Mandatory receive-only AM reception from 118 to 137 MHz reuses the existing FM/SW antenna port and Si4732 audio path. Airband transmit, VDL Mode 2 and certified navigation are excluded.

compute_domains.role: application, S3-local UI-expander path, touch, direct encoder, direct 8-bit i8080 display path, simultaneous analog-video capture and native 2.4-GHz Wi-Fi/BLE

rear RF/I/O domain: onboard CC1101, independent VHF/UHF voice radios, FM/AM/SW/LW/Airband, audio, FPV control, M5 Unit and exactly one signed U214 LoRa/GNSS or U219 receive-only CC1101/NFC Cap profile
front UI/radio domain: dedicated fan-out for S3, C5 and rear RP, microSD plus three fully concurrent local nRF24 paths
cell admission, pack diagnostics and protected shutdown
independent watchdog, thermal supervision, TX lease/evidence and FAULT_KILL

dedicated direct 8-bit i8080 with LCD_CAM TX and GDMA; panel CS is hard-selected, TE/backlight control is front-Hub-local and microSD is independent

raw/demodulated receive, learning and transmit retained

independent SA818S-V and SA818S-U paths with hardware one-hot selection retained

ui_contract.ordinary_buttons: All sixteen independent active-low inputs terminate on the local TCA9539PWR. Its 400-kHz I2C and dedicated active-low interrupt connect directly to S3; there is no Hub/RF-RP message hop and no polling-only path.
ui_contract.encoder: A/B remain dedicated S3 PCNT inputs; encoder push is one TCA9539 input.
ui_contract.ptt_exception: PTT remains direct to RF RP for fail-safe radio control and is mirrored to S3 as state/event data.
ui_contract.latency_target: button edge to S3 event <=1 ms and first visible response <=20 ms under qualified concurrent load
ui_contract.bus_priority: The wired-OR UI_HUB_ALERT_N is sourced only by open-drain UI/touch/fault interrupt outputs and the front Hub RP. Button/touch source identification preempts the next bounded internal I2C transaction; no external hot-plug bus is connected to this branch.

interboard_rebaseline.connector: FX8C-80P-SV1(92) / FX8C-80S-SV5(92), straight SMT, 80 contacts, 11-mm working gap
interboard_rebaseline.why_not_20_or_60: The current 4.25-A step envelope receives fourteen parallel 3V3_MAIN contacts and fourteen primary return contacts, leaving 0.304 A per power contact versus the 0.4-A rating before H3/H5 thermal proof. After two AON contacts, signal-reference returns and 25 live signals, a 60-contact pair has no controlled reserve; 80 is the smallest current FX8C size that preserves both derating and fourteen NC contacts.
interboard_rebaseline.video: K331 remains rear-local; one 75-ohm FPV_CVBS net crosses M1 beside a dedicated return. TVP5150 and all eight data lines plus PCLK/VSYNC/HREF remain UI-local beside S3.

locality_contract.rule: Every payload endpoint stays on the board that owns its controller. M1 carries no display bus, camera parallel bus, nRF/SPI payload, microSD payload, main RF trace or audio stream.

intentional_crossings.hub_rf_ipc: five point-to-point Hub-RF control/data wires are the sole compute-domain message path
intentional_crossings.fpv_cvbs: one rear-receiver analog CVBS feed crosses to the front-local decoder beside its dedicated return
intentional_crossings.s3_usb: the rear/bottom power-and-service receptacle reaches the front S3 native USB pair directly
intentional_crossings.encoder: the externally reachable rear encoder remains direct to S3 PCNT plus one local-expander push input
intentional_crossings.safety_and_evidence: AON safety, thermal and TX-evidence nets cross to the rear safety controller by design

interboard_rebaseline.mechanical_load_path: M1 is electrical/alignment only. Four 11.00-mm compression stops, two anti-shear enclosure datums and independent front/rear PCB capture lips constrain the boards when one screw is loose; no drop, installation or enclosure-bending load is accepted through the SMT joints.
interboard_rebaseline.result: R2 uses 25 live signals, fourteen 3V3_MAIN contacts, twenty-five defined returns, two AON contacts and fourteen true NC reserve contacts; no obsolete audio or M5 signal remains assigned.

transport_contracts.reason: Carries control and selected data only; display and analog video never traverse IPC.

transport_contracts.service_mux: C5 GPIO13/14 are switched between SDIO D3/D2 and the independent service USB connector; service mode stops and resets the runtime link before switching.

transport_contracts.reason: Three nRF paths are now front-local and do not consume this link. Worst-case full-duplex 48-kHz audio is below 0.4 MB/s; rear radio control, activity and recording metadata remain bounded below the remaining floor.
The existing accepted recording requirement is met without using the S3 display peripheral or crossing S3_HUB for local captures.
Carries Pack read-only state and Safety heartbeat/lease/fault mailboxes; local Safety hardware still owns watchdog service and asynchronous FAULT_KILL.

display_contract.interface: dedicated direct i8080-8 (Intel 8080) on S3 LCD_CAM TX with GDMA; D0..D7, WR and DC are direct, CS is hard-low because the bus is exclusive, RD is hard-high, IM[2:0]=111, reset remains on the local slow-I/O output, and front Hub captures TE plus drives reset-off backlight PWM
display_contract.controller_limit_basis: ST77922 preliminary v0.1 table 7.4.1 specifies a 26-ns minimum 8080 write cycle and 13-ns minimum WR high/low widths; 32 MHz gives a 31.25-ns cycle and 15.625-ns half-period.
display_contract.s3_supported_sources: ESP32-S3 LCD_CAM has separate LCD TX and camera RX control units, supports simultaneous external LCD and camera connection, an 8-bit i8080 output and GDMA. The selected 32-MHz write clock is below both the S3 8-bit-i80 guidance and ST77922 timing limit.
display_contract.video_window: 320x240 RGB565 at 30 fps is 4.608 MB/s and 14.4% of the selected i8080 payload
display_contract.gpio_closure: All 33 exposed S3 GPIO are assigned: 11 camera RX, 10 direct i8080 outputs, 5 chip-select-free S3-Hub quad data/clock, 2 UI I2C, 2 USB, 2 encoder and 1 wired-OR UI/Hub alert. TE and backlight PWM consume Hub GPIO45/46 instead of S3 pins.
display_contract.fallback: The same 40-contact HMX035CTFT-001 tail still exposes the former QSPI contacts. A build-option QSPI strap/zero-ohm population is retained only as first-prototype recovery if simultaneous LCD_CAM TX/RX or the i8080 timing gate fails; it is not the preferred production interface.
display_contract.maximality_result: Direct i8080-8 is 1.6x faster than the previous legal 40-MHz QSPI wire rate without adding a processor, moving buttons off S3 or sharing display traffic with storage/radio IPC.
display_contract.hil: Before fabrication, compile and run the simultaneous LCD_TX/CAM_RX DMA harness on the emulator-supported register model. H5 then proves ST77922 IM straps, 32-MHz edges, TE timestamp latency, full-frame/dirty-region timing and live BT.656 capture; 36 MHz is measurement-only and never assumed.

video_contract.rf: replaceable exact serial analog 5.8-GHz receiver module; generic RX5808 is evidence input, not an accepted MPN
video_contract.external_connector: MMCX, DC to at least 6 GHz, user-facing and labelled FPV RX 5.8G
video_contract.decoder: Texas Instruments TVP5150AM1PBS or industrial-temperature TVP5150AM1IPBS after factory-route confirmation
video_contract.capture: Rear K331 CVBS crosses one M1 signal beside ground into UI-local TVP5150; its 8-bit YUV422 plus PCLK/VSYNC/HREF enters the independent S3 LCD_CAM camera RX/GDMA path while the LCD TX unit drives i8080 concurrently
video_contract.first_acceptance_mode: NTSC/PAL source to centered 320x240 live view at source frame rate with UI overlay/remaining portrait area; uncompressed full-source recording is not promised
video_contract.coexistence: Entering FPV mode powers the receiver/decoder group, disables C5 5-GHz RF and all unused transmit groups, and preserves the one-active-signal-group rule.
video_contract.power_thermal_gate: Receiver, decoder, regulator and local shielding are added to the unattended thermal and battery budgets before H1 acceptance.

airband_contract.antenna_port: the existing outward standard-SMA port is relabelled FM / SW / AIR RX; no eleventh antenna connector is added
airband_contract.signal_group: BROADCAST_RX remains the exclusive top-level receive group; FM, SW, AM/LW and AIR are mutually exclusive submodes
rf_chain: shared FM/SW/AIR SMA protection and mode split
existing Si4732-A10-GSR FMI and audio path

frequency_plan.image_rejection_rule: The 118-137-MHz input filter is mandatory because the fixed low-side LO maps the 87-106-MHz FM broadcast band onto the same IF range.

control.i2c: SI5351A-B-GTR joins the isolated rear-RP-local I2C bus at address 0x60; it does not share S3 UI I2C
control.gp35: AIR_RX_EN is pulled low and removes the Airband RF/LO domain when unused
control.gp36: AIR_RX_MODE defaults to the direct FM/SW path before rear-RP firmware starts
control.quiet_state: Airband LNA, mixer and LO are electrically off outside AIR mode; inactive RF paths cannot clock or load the selected receiver input

performance_boundary.hil: H1 simulation and H7 injection tests must prove sensitivity, blocker tolerance, LO leakage, image rejection across 118-137 MHz and direct-FM/SW degradation before the path is accepted.

lines.role: existing FM/AM/SW/LW receiver reused for 6-25-MHz IF
lines.route: existing R1 line; no incremental quantity

filter_route.production_implementation: serial high-Q LC passives from the current JLCPCB library, selected after H1 synthesis, tolerance/finite-Q simulation and layout extraction
filter_route.acceptance_mask: <=4.5-dB insertion loss from 118 to 137 MHz and blocker/image rejection not worse than the BPF-A127+ reference at the named H1/H7 test points
filter_route.order_gate: every passive MPN, live factory route, stock, MOQ and cost must be rechecked before architecture freeze and again before order

power_rebaseline.r1_status: The reviewed R1 2.493-A worst state and 2.5-A continuous rail are historical only because R2 adds an always-present Hub RP plus FPV and Airband domains.

airband_increment.rail: switched low-noise 3.0-V RF domain plus Hub-local 3.3-V control
airband_increment.basis: PGA-103+ 60 mA at 3 V; LT5560 up to 12 mA at 3 V; SI5351 core plus one output up to 40.6 mA; selector/control/filter margin included

power_rebaseline.coexistence: FPV and Airband are never powered together; both remain mutually exclusive with unused transmit groups under the one-active-signal-group rule.

h1_required_envelope.action: retain the selected 6-A buck/eFuse/inductor working set and prove the complete six-domain rail/state matrix, effective capacitance, copper and thermal path in H3 before layout release

reopen_effect.hardware: R1 H1 through H5 artifacts remain historical evidence only. Current work resumes at H1-R2.0 after this reviewed H0-R2 contract.
reopen_effect.firmware: The previous five-image H2/F2 contract is superseded. R2 has six firmware domains and requires a Hub target, new transports and analog-video/display scheduling before F1-R2 can close.
reopen_effect.ordering: All prior sample baskets and factory-route counts are non-current; no purchase or PCB layout is authorized by H0-R2.

exit_review.interboard: 80 contacts: 25 live signals, 14 main-power, 2 AON, 25 defined returns and 14 NC reserves; M1 carries no structural load
exit_review.display: direct 8-bit i8080 at a conservative 32 MHz with simultaneous LCD_TX/CAM_RX GDMA; QSPI is recovery-only
exit_review.ui: local interrupt-driven S3 ownership, no IPC
exit_review.video: direct capture path with exact active decoder and replaceable receiver boundary
